sections.title: Welcome to Real Numbers!
learning_goals: Get ready to explore the fascinating world of real numbers and their properties.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Standard introductory section with avatar-only presentation.

sections.title: What You'll Learn Today
learning_goals: Define and classify real numbers, including rational and irrational numbers.
Understand the Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic and its applications.
Learn to find HCF and LCM using prime factorization.
Explore how to prove the irrationality of numbers like √2.
Apply these concepts to solve real-world problems.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Standard summary section outlining learning objectives with avatar and bullet points.

sections.title: Understanding Real Numbers and Their Classification
learning_goals: Define real numbers and their representation on a number line.
Distinguish between rational and irrational numbers.
Classify numbers into natural, whole, integers, rational, and irrational categories.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim is ideal for illustrating number lines, Venn diagrams for classification, and showing the p/q form of rational numbers.

sections.title: The Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic
learning_goals: State and explain the Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic.
Understand the concept of unique prime factorization for composite numbers.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim can visually demonstrate prime factorization trees and the uniqueness of prime factors for numbers.

sections.title: Applying Prime Factorization to Find HCF and LCM
learning_goals: Perform prime factorization for given numbers.
Calculate the HCF and LCM of two or more numbers using their prime factorizations.
Understand the relationship between HCF, LCM, and the product of two numbers.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim is excellent for step-by-step demonstrations of prime factorization and the algorithms for finding HCF and LCM.

sections.title: Proof of Irrationality: The Case of Root 2
learning_goals: Understand the method of proof by contradiction.
Follow the logical steps to prove that √2 is an irrational number.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim can clearly present mathematical proofs, highlighting each step and equation in the proof by contradiction for irrationality.

sections.title: Solving Word Problems with HCF and LCM
learning_goals: Identify when to use HCF or LCM to solve real-world problems.
Apply HCF and LCM concepts to practical scenarios like circular tracks and equal divisions.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim can animate word problems, showing how quantities relate and how HCF/LCM are applied to find solutions.

sections.title: Test Your Knowledge!
learning_goals: Assess understanding of real numbers, FTA, HCF, LCM, and irrationality proofs.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Interactive quiz section using flashcard-style display for questions and answers.

sections.title: Key Concepts to Remember
learning_goals: Reinforce understanding of key definitions and theorems related to real numbers.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Flashcard-style review of key terms and concepts for memory retention.

sections.title: Real Numbers: A Quick Review
learning_goals: Summarize the main topics covered in the video, reinforcing key takeaways.
sections.renderer_reasoning: A dynamic video recap helps to visually reinforce the concepts learned throughout the lesson.
